description: A trekking agency site: three treks with days, cost and season, how a trip is arranged, and an enquiry form.

settings.tagline: Small-group treks in Langtang, Annapurna and Mustang
settings.address: Thamel Marg, Kathmandu 44600, above Himalayan Java

props.about: Registered with the Nepal Tourism Board and TAAN. Our guides are licensed, first-aid trained, and are paid and insured whatever the weather does.

pages.title: Home
pages.seoTitle: Sherpa Trail Nepal, Thamel: small-group treks in Langtang, Annapurna, Mustang
pages.seoDescription: Licensed trekking agency in Thamel. Langtang 8 days from USD 780, Annapurna Base Camp 11 days, Upper Mustang. Groups of six or fewer.

props.title: Six people, one guide, one porter for every two
props.text: Trips run by guides who grew up on the trails they lead. We keep groups to six so the teahouse is not full before you get there.

image.alt: A trekker looking at snow peaks

items.title: Langtang Valley
items.text: Syabrubesi to Kyanjin Gompa and back, through rebuilt villages and rhododendron forest.

items.title: Annapurna Base Camp
items.text: From Pokhara via Ghandruk and Chomrong, with a sunrise at the sanctuary.

items.title: Upper Mustang
items.text: Kagbeni to Lo Manthang. A restricted-area permit is arranged for you.

image.alt: A person on a rocky ridge above the clouds

props.heading: You will always know how high you are and how you are doing
props.body: Guides check oxygen saturation every evening above 3,000 metres, and every group carries a Gamow bag and a satellite phone. Turning back is always the guide's call, and never costs you extra.

image.alt: Snow peaks under a starry sky

props.title: Best months are Kartik, Mangsir and Chaitra
props.text: Groups fill six weeks ahead in October and November.

pages.title: Treks
pages.seoTitle: Trek itineraries and prices: Langtang, Annapurna, Mustang with Sherpa Trail
pages.seoDescription: Langtang 8 days USD 780, Annapurna Base Camp 11 days USD 1,050, Upper Mustang 14 days USD 2,950. What is included and when to go.

props.heading: Treks and prices
props.intro: Per person, sharing a room, in a group of four to six. Prices include permits, guide, porter, teahouse rooms and three meals a day. International flights and insurance are not included.

items.title: Kathmandu to Syabrubesi
items.text: Seven-hour bus ride. Night in a teahouse.

items.title: To Lama Hotel
items.text: Six hours through oak and rhododendron forest.

items.title: To Langtang village
items.text: Rebuilt after the 2015 earthquake. Yak cheese for lunch.

items.title: Kyanjin Gompa
items.text: A short day to help you acclimatise.

items.title: Kyanjin Ri or rest
items.text: The 4,773 metre viewpoint, if you feel well.

items.title: Back to Syabrubesi, then Kathmandu
items.text: Downhill in two days and a bus on the third.

items.q: Do I need to be very fit?
items.a: For Langtang, no. If you can walk six hours on hilly ground with a small pack, you are ready.
We build in rest days, and your guide watches every person. If you are unwell, we descend.
A 30 percent deposit by bank transfer or card, the rest in Kathmandu before you leave.
